title: Fixed-size stabilization and numerator relations for a localized conormal basis
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings and A a finitely presented R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let P₀ be a polynomial presentation of A with n₀ variables and m₀ relations [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and put B = A_a for a ∈ A [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. If (B ⊗_A Cotangent(P₀)) × B^r is B-linearly isomorphic to B^q, then there are m ≥ q and a presentation P of A on exactly n₀+r variables with m relations such that the localized conormal classes of its first q relations are a B-basis indexed by Fin q. No smoothness or bound q ≤ n₀+r is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 07EZ, proof of part (e), stabilization paragraph

proof.text: Adjoin r polynomial variables z_i mapped to zero. The new kernel J is generated by the old relations and z_i. The constant term modulo I² and the linear coefficients modulo I give J/J² ≃ (I/I²) × A^r. The inverse takes (g,(b_i)) to g+sum lift(b_i)z_i modulo J²; coefficient-lift changes and all terms of z-degree at least two lie in J². These descriptions show well-definedness, linearity and the inverse identities. Reindex the polynomial variables by Fin (n₀+r).

Tensor the equivalence with B and compose with the assumed stable trivialization, obtaining a basis with exactly q vectors. Under the tensor/localization equivalence every basis vector is a localized conormal class g_j/a^e_j, with g_j in J. Scale each basis vector by the corresponding unit a^e_j to obtain a basis of numerator classes. This is valid also for q=0 and for B the zero ring.

Use the q numerator relations first, followed by the original relations and the r zero variables. This finite list generates J because its appended subfamily already does. Reindex it by Fin m, preserving its first q entries. The resulting presentation has q≤m and its first q relation classes are exactly the rescaled basis.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stabilized_presentation_localized_conormal_basis
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [FinitePresentation R A] (a : A)
    {n₀ m₀ : ℕ} (P₀ : Presentation R A (Fin n₀) (Fin m₀)) (r q : ℕ)
    (hstable : Nonempty
      (((Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P₀.toExtension.Cotangent) ×
        (Fin r → Localization.Away a)) ≃ₗ[Localization.Away a]
        (Fin q → Localization.Away a))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin (n₀ + r)) (Fin m)) (hc : q ≤ m)
      (b : Module.Basis (Fin q) (Localization.Away a)
        (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.Cotangent)),
      ∀ j : Fin q, b j = 1 ⊗ₜ[A]
        (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P.toExtension)
          ⟨P.relation (Fin.castLE hc j),
            P.relation_mem_ker _⟩)
